Subject: Technical walkthrough + procurement/security sync for AcmeWorks

Hi Liam —

Great to meet last week. Per our conversations, we'd like to schedule a 60-minute technical walkthrough with our Solutions Engineering (Karthik) plus a short procurement/security touchpoint so your procurement and infosec folks can confirm requirements. Proposed goals:

- 30–40 minute SE demo covering integration patterns, KV cache behavior, and token/cost considerations
- 15 minute security overview (SOC2, data separation, on-prem options)
- 5–10 minute next steps / mutual action plan

Proposed windows next week (PT):
- Tue 2027-03-22 10:00–11:00
- Wed 2027-03-23 13:00–14:00
- Thu 2027-03-24 14:00–15:00

Who from your side should join? We suggest: one lead engineer (integration), one security contact, and procurement (for billing/contract). Attaching a brief agenda — happy to tweak.

(Attachment: redwood-se-technical-agenda.pdf)

Thanks,
Ben Carter

Thanks Ben —

All sounds good. Quick notes from our side:
- Procurement (cc’d Priya) prefers Monday/Tuesday afternoons if possible — they have a standing review slot.
- Security (Samir) wants a short SOC2/controls summary before the meeting. Can you share that?
- Attendees: Samir Gupta (Lead Platform Eng), Priya Shah (Head of Procurement), myself. We may also have a QA engineer join.

Can you do Mon 2027-03-22 after 13:00 PT? If so we’ll lock it.

—Liam

Hi Liam — looping in Karthik (SE) to propose a concrete slot. Karthik — Ben suggested Tue/Wed/Thu options; Liam asked for Mon/Tue afternoon if possible.

Karthik and I are available Mon 2027-03-22 13:00–14:00 PT for a 60-minute session (we can extend to 75 if required). We’ll plan the run of show as Ben outlined. I’ve attached a short SOC2 summary and the agenda Ben shared.

Pre-demo asks for your team, to make the session as productive as possible:
- A short description of your integration pattern (webhook vs. direct API)
- Expected request concurrency and typical sequence lengths (tokens per request)
- Any specific security questions to prioritize (encryption at rest, PII handling, audit logs)

(Attachment: soc2-summary.pdf)

Thanks — we’ll hold the slot tentatively pending procurement confirmation.

Best,

Thanks all —

Mon 13:00 PT works for AcmeWorks procurement team, though we prefer 14:00 PT if that’s easier for Redwood. A couple of procurement items before invite:

- Can you provide billing contact + address for invoicing?
- We need a short statement on data residency options (where logs are stored) and whether Redwood supports customer-managed KMS for key control.

If you can share those quickly we’ll finalize the calendar invite.

Hi team —

13:00 PT on Mon is OK for now but I have a conflicting internal roll call; would it be possible to shift to 15:00–16:00 PT on Mon 2027-03-22 instead? That slot keeps the technical portion within working hours for everyone on my side.

Pre-demo checklist from SE:
- Example payload (or a sanitized sample) — helps us size memory and KV cache usage
- Expected concurrency (QPS) and average tokens per request
- Any on-prem/VPC requirements (we can cover options in the session)

If Monday 15:00 PT works for you, I’ll prepare a short deep-dive on integration patterns and a troubleshooting checklist.

Thanks,
